MCF-DEP-001.rationale: Asset-to-function mapping covers power, cooling and compute but omits the facility water plant and recovery dependencies (F-001).

MCF-RES-017.rationale: Component tests evidenced only by operational records; no E4 test evidence at the S3 floor, so the result is UNKNOWN (U-001).

MCF-SEC-005.title: BMS and EPMS Security
MCF-SEC-005.rationale: BMS and EPMS security controls partly effective; write authority to the BMS controller is not restricted to named identities (F-005).

MCF-STO-017.title: Checkpoint Durability

MCF-SUP-021.title: Support Identity
MCF-SUP-021.rationale: Support identity controls exist for the remote-access conduit, but vendor accounts are not time-bound (F-004).

MCF-THM-009.title: Direct-to-Chip Architecture
MCF-THM-009.rationale: Direct-to-chip design reviewed; the design basis does not state cold-plate flow at the transient envelope (F-002).

errata.location: AIDCF-015 v1.3 synthetic case: the decision question in dataset/decision.jsonld and dataset/assessment.jsonld (built by tools/build_dataset.py); whitepaper v3.1 section on the synthetic case
errata.erratum: The decision question asks whether CI-001 meets SO-01 to SO-03 in NORMAL and MAINTENANCE states. Those are the states the assessment covers, but they do not match the outcomes: SO-02 applies only in RECOVERY, and SO-03 applies in NORMAL and DEGRADED. Within the assessed scope, SO-02 is not assessed at all and SO-03 is assessed only in NORMAL.
errata.correction: The question should read: "Can the synthetic AI training and inference capability CI-001 be relied on to meet SO-01 to SO-03, as far as they apply in NORMAL and MAINTENANCE states, as at 2026-10-10? SO-02 (RECOVERY only) and the DEGRADED state of SO-03 are outside the assessed scope." The computed decision, gate results, score and coverage do not change. Corrected in the next release of AIDCF-015.
